q1_issues.issue: The direct object "an 8-under 64" is absent entirely — the shoot event carries no Theme/Patient and no score referent is minted anywhere, so the parse never records what Howell shot.
(Past sk_impart_1) tenses a participial reduced relative ("imparted by Nicklaus"), which carries no tense atom of its own.
(Past sk_buoy_1) tenses the free participial adjunct "Buoyed by …" the same way.

(To sk_shoot_1 sk_enter_1) treats a result/outcome infinitive ("shot a 64 … to enter today's round with a lead") as a purpose infinitive, which the instruction set bars because the purpose `To` feeds the seeded PurposeOf bridge and would assert an aim the text does not state.

q2_gaps: A par-relative score nominal ("an 8-under 64"): a bare numeral used as a noun with a relative-to-baseline modifier and no stated scale or unit.
A result/outcome infinitive: the instruction set explicitly registers that it has no licensed connective, so the outcome relation here cannot be recorded at all.
A free participial adjunct ("Buoyed by X, Howell shot …") whose relation to the matrix clause has no licensed carrier.
notes: Deictic and calendar handling ("on Thursday" → (Weekday thursday), "today's round" → the bare constant on the event-noun) and the tenseless infinitival complement are right. The headline defect is that the clause's direct object simply never appears.
